attachmentFields.description: The list of fields that are attachments. This is automatically populated by the form config visitor.

behaviours.description: Top-level behaviour config copied during construct and then transformed by the template/client visitors before reaching the Angular runtime.

items.description:
Top-level behaviour definition stored on `FormConfigFrame.behaviours`.

Design notes:
- `condition` / `conditionKind` intentionally reuse expression semantics
- `debounceMs` applies at subscription level, not per processor
- `hasCondition` is a client-side marker added after template stripping
- `enabled` exists so a behaviour can remain in config without binding

Future work anticipated by the plan:
- more processors/actions
- hook extensibility
- richer UI-facing actions

config.description:
`fieldPath` points at an `angularComponentsJsonPointer`.

Resolution modes intentionally mirror the implementation plan:
- `componentJsonPointer`: literal pointer resolved at execution time
- `jsonata`: compiled template resolved against the current pipeline context
- `logical`: repeatable-only identity lock that survives row reindexing

Note that `logical` is validated by the runtime and is intentionally not allowed on `onError` actions in v1.
v1 keeps emitted events deliberately narrow to avoid inventing another event contract before behaviour usage patterns settle.

`fieldPath` points at an `angularComponentsJsonPointer`.

Resolution modes intentionally mirror the implementation plan:
- `componentJsonPointer`: literal pointer resolved at execution time
- `jsonata`: compiled template resolved against the current pipeline context
- `logical`: repeatable-only identity lock that survives row reindexing

Note that `logical` is validated by the runtime and is intentionally not allowed on `onError` actions in v1.
v1 keeps emitted events deliberately narrow to avoid inventing another event contract before behaviour usage patterns settle.

Configuration for the v1 JSONata processor.

The server keeps `template` long enough to compile it, while the client uses `hasTemplate` after the raw source has been stripped by the client visitor.

angularComponents.description: A lineage path is an ordered list of keys (string|number) describing a path lineage for different domains of form configuration. A string key is a property name or array index number as a string, a number key is an array index.

layout.description: A lineage path is an ordered list of keys (string|number) describing a path lineage for different domains of form configuration. A string key is a property name or array index number as a string, a number key is an array index.

groups.description:
Zero or more validation group names this validator belongs to.

Validation groups make it easier to run a subset of validators on a form. The validator will be enabled if any of the groups it is part of are enabled.

Note that a validation group with 'initialMembership: "all"' will include all validators (that aren't excluded), even if the validators do not include the group name.

exclude.description:
A list of the validation groups to exclude / remove / disable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be excluded from a group with initial membership of all.

include.description:
A list of the validation groups to include / add / enable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be included in a group with initial membership of none.

message.description: The optional message id to display when the validator fails. This is only needed if the message to show is different to the validator definition.

value.description:
The current value of this model.

The 'value' is only available after the form config has been processed, and the default values or the existing record values have been populated.

targetField.description: Lineage paths to a target field that will 'own' any validation failures.

layout.description: A lineage path is an ordered list of keys (string|number) describing a path lineage for different domains of form configuration. A string key is a property name or array index number as a string, a number key is an array index.

groups.description:
Zero or more validation group names this validator belongs to.

Validation groups make it easier to run a subset of validators on a form. The validator will be enabled if any of the groups it is part of are enabled.

Note that a validation group with 'initialMembership: "all"' will include all validators (that aren't excluded), even if the validators do not include the group name.

exclude.description:
A list of the validation groups to exclude / remove / disable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be excluded from a group with initial membership of all.

include.description:
A list of the validation groups to include / add / enable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be included in a group with initial membership of none.

message.description: The optional message id to display when the validator fails. This is only needed if the message to show is different to the validator definition.

groups.description:
Zero or more validation group names this validator belongs to.

Validation groups make it easier to run a subset of validators on a form. The validator will be enabled if any of the groups it is part of are enabled.

Note that a validation group with 'initialMembership: "all"' will include all validators (that aren't excluded), even if the validators do not include the group name.

include.description:

groups.description:
Zero or more validation group names this validator belongs to.

Validation groups make it easier to run a subset of validators on a form. The validator will be enabled if any of the groups it is part of are enabled.

Note that a validation group with 'initialMembership: "all"' will include all validators (that aren't excluded), even if the validators do not include the group name.

exclude.description:
A list of the validation groups to exclude / remove / disable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be excluded from a group with initial membership of all.

include.description:
A list of the validation groups to include / add / enable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be included in a group with initial membership of none.

message.description: The optional message id to display when the validator fails. This is only needed if the message to show is different to the validator definition.

groups.description:

Validation groups make it easier to run a subset of validators on a form. The validator will be enabled if any of the groups it is part of are enabled.

include.description:

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be included in a group with initial membership of none.

groups.description:

Validation groups make it easier to run a subset of validators on a form. The validator will be enabled if any of the groups it is part of are enabled.

groups.description:

Validation groups make it easier to run a subset of validators on a form. The validator will be enabled if any of the groups it is part of are enabled.

include.description:

groups.description:
Zero or more validation group names this validator belongs to.

Validation groups make it easier to run a subset of validators on a form. The validator will be enabled if any of the groups it is part of are enabled.

Note that a validation group with 'initialMembership: "all"' will include all validators (that aren't excluded), even if the validators do not include the group name.

exclude.description:
A list of the validation groups to exclude / remove / disable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be excluded from a group with initial membership of all.

include.description:
A list of the validation groups to include / add / enable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be included in a group with initial membership of none.

message.description: The optional message id to display when the validator fails. This is only needed if the message to show is different to the validator definition.

groups.description:
Zero or more validation group names this validator belongs to.

Validation groups make it easier to run a subset of validators on a form. The validator will be enabled if any of the groups it is part of are enabled.

Note that a validation group with 'initialMembership: "all"' will include all validators (that aren't excluded), even if the validators do not include the group name.

exclude.description:
A list of the validation groups to exclude / remove / disable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be excluded from a group with initial membership of all.

include.description:
A list of the validation groups to include / add / enable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be included in a group with initial membership of none.

message.description: The optional message id to display when the validator fails. This is only needed if the message to show is different to the validator definition.

value.description:

config.description: The configuration specific to the class of this form field.

autofocus.description: Whether the component has autofocus or not.

disabled.description:
Whether the component is disabled or not.

Note that disabled affects only the component's interactivity. Disabled is separate from readonly, they can be set independently.

editMode.description: Whether the component is in edit mode or not.

hostCssClasses.description: The css classes to bind to host

label.description: The label text translation message id.

clearValue.description: Value to set when selection is cleared. Defaults to null. Should be type-compatible with the target control (e.g. string for text inputs, null for optional fields).

rawPath.description: Dot-path into selectedItem.raw (or selectedItem) to extract this field's value

readonly.description:
Whether the component is read-only or not.

Note that readonly affects only the component's interactivity. Readonly is separate from disabled, they can be set independently.

showValidIndicator.description: Whether to show a visual valid indicator (e.g. Bootstrap is-valid style) when the field has no errors. Defaults to false.

syncSources.description: Declares source fields for one-way additive sync.

items.description: Declares a source field for one-way additive sync.

blankCheckFields.description: Optional list of item fields to inspect when deciding whether an existing repeatable row is still a blank placeholder.

defaultTemplate.description: Optional object merged into synced rows before insertion/update. This allows sync behavior to stay generic while individual configs provide domain-specific defaults such as roles.

fieldName.description: formData key to read the source data from. The source value may be a single object or an array of objects; array values are synced item by item.

syncKey.description: Optional property on the source object to use as the dedupe/upsert key. When omitted, consumers may fall back to component-specific defaults.

visibilityConditionField.description: Optional formData key whose value determines whether this source is active.

visibilityConditionValues.description: Values of the condition field that make this source active.

tooltip.description: The tooltip text translation message id.

visible.description: Whether the component is visible or not.

wrapperCssClasses.description: The wrapper css classes to bind to host

constraints.description: Constraints / prerequisites for this component to be included in the form definition.

allowModes.description: This form field is included when the displayed form is in one of these modes. If this is not specified, the form field will be included in all modes.

items.description: The available form modes as a typescript type.

authorization.description: The current user must fulfill these authorization constraints. This is only available on the server side. These are checked first.

allowRoles.description:
The current user must have at least one of these roles for the form field to be included.

defaultValue.description:
The default value for this model.

The server-side processing uses this as the default for the field. Defaults from ancestor fields will be combined to form the default value for a new record.

disabled.description:
Whether the form control should be disabled.

Disabled controls are excluded from the parent form's value.

Note that disabled here affects only the model's disabled state. Components can be disabled or not and readonly or not, independent of this property. Some components must link the component and model disabled state due to angular FormControl requirements.

newEntryValue.description:
The value to use when creating new entries in the repeatable.

Only available in a repeatable's elementTemplate in 'model.config.newEntryValue'.

The default value for a repeatable is specified in 'model.config.defaultValue'. The value for a repeatable is in 'model.config.value'.

validators.description: The validators that are configured at the field level that look at only this model.

items.description: The configuration block for a validator for a form or a form control.

class.description: The 'class' key used to reference one validator definition. The optional message and config will be applied to the validator definition with this class.

config.description: The optional validator config. Can be left out if the validator takes no config.

errorKey.description:
The key to use for this validator's entry in the merged errors object.

Defaults to the class. Set to a unique value when the same class is used more than once on a control, so Angular's error merging does not overwrite earlier instances.

targetField.description: Lineage paths to a target field that will 'own' any validation failures.

angularComponents.description: A lineage path is an ordered list of keys (string|number) describing a path lineage for different domains of form configuration. A string key is a property name or array index number as a string, a number key is an array index.

dataModel.description: A lineage path is an ordered list of keys (string|number) describing a path lineage for different domains of form configuration. A string key is a property name or array index number as a string, a number key is an array index.

formConfig.description: A lineage path is an ordered list of keys (string|number) describing a path lineage for different domains of form configuration. A string key is a property name or array index number as a string, a number key is an array index.

layout.description: A lineage path is an ordered list of keys (string|number) describing a path lineage for different domains of form configuration. A string key is a property name or array index number as a string, a number key is an array index.

groups.description:
Zero or more validation group names this validator belongs to.

Validation groups make it easier to run a subset of validators on a form. The validator will be enabled if any of the groups it is part of are enabled.

Note that a validation group with 'initialMembership: "all"' will include all validators (that aren't excluded), even if the validators do not include the group name.

exclude.description:
A list of the validation groups to exclude / remove / disable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be excluded from a group with initial membership of all.

include.description:
A list of the validation groups to include / add / enable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be included in a group with initial membership of none.

message.description: The optional message id to display when the validator fails. This is only needed if the message to show is different to the validator definition.

value.description:
The current value of this model.

The 'value' is only available after the form config has been processed, and the default values or the existing record values have been populated.

wrapperCssClasses.description: The optional css classes to be applied to the wrapper element.

module.description: For a custom form component definition, module defines where to find the definition.

overrides.description: Optional ways to extend or replace parts of the form config.

template.description: When the mode's transform produces a ContentComponent, this Handlebars template replaces the generated one. It renders with the client content-component context (`content` = the field's pruned value, plus `formData`, `branding`, `portal`, `oid`, `workflow`). The transformed component is made visible so edit-mode visibility defaults do not suppress the custom view. A layout hidden for edit mode is shown when transformed content is non-empty and remains hidden when it is empty. It is ignored when no transform to ContentComponent occurs.

groups.description:
Zero or more validation group names this validator belongs to.

Validation groups make it easier to run a subset of validators on a form. The validator will be enabled if any of the groups it is part of are enabled.

Note that a validation group with 'initialMembership: "all"' will include all validators (that aren't excluded), even if the validators do not include the group name.

exclude.description:
A list of the validation groups to exclude / remove / disable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be excluded from a group with initial membership of all.

include.description:
A list of the validation groups to include / add / enable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be included in a group with initial membership of none.

message.description: The optional message id to display when the validator fails. This is only needed if the message to show is different to the validator definition.

Validation groups make it easier to run a subset of validators on a form. The validator will be enabled if any of the groups it is part of are enabled.

enabledValidationGroups.description:
The validation groups to enable for the form. The validation groups will be set as part of loading the form. Default ["all"] if none specified.

In the angular form:
- The available validation groups cannot change.
- The groups a validator belongs to cannot change.
- The currently enabled validation groups can change.

It is possible to change the enabled validation groups after the form has loaded. This is done by changing this property in the Form Component config. Use component expressions with target 'form.enabledValidationGroups' to trigger the event.

Use Cases for whether a validator is enabled or disabled in the angular form.

Must change as the user is interacting with the form:  - Enabled only when a component is visible (or hidden), and disabled otherwise.  - Enabled based on the value in another component.  - Enabled when a particular system integration / external state is activated or changed, and disabled otherwise.

 Change based on state provided from the server that does not change in the angular form:  - Disabled for a new form, but enabled for a saved form.  - Enabled for some workflow stages, but disabled in other stages.

The default value for this model.

The server-side processing uses this as the default for the field. Defaults from ancestor fields will be combined to form the default value for a new record.

groups.description:
Zero or more validation group names this validator belongs to.

Validation groups make it easier to run a subset of validators on a form. The validator will be enabled if any of the groups it is part of are enabled.

Note that a validation group with 'initialMembership: "all"' will include all validators (that aren't excluded), even if the validators do not include the group name.

exclude.description:
A list of the validation groups to exclude / remove / disable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be excluded from a group with initial membership of all.

include.description:
A list of the validation groups to include / add / enable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be included in a group with initial membership of none.

message.description: The optional message id to display when the validator fails. This is only needed if the message to show is different to the validator definition.

template.description: When the mode's transform produces a ContentComponent, this Handlebars template replaces the generated one. It renders with the client content-component context (`content` = the field's pruned value, plus `formData`, `branding`, `portal`, `oid`, `workflow`). groups.description:
Zero or more validation group names this validator belongs to.

Validation groups make it easier to run a subset of validators on a form. The validator will be enabled if any of the groups it is part of are enabled.

Note that a validation group with 'initialMembership: "all"' will include all validators (that aren't excluded), even if the validators do not include the group name.

exclude.description:
A list of the validation groups to exclude / remove / disable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be excluded from a group with initial membership of all.

include.description:
A list of the validation groups to include / add / enable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be included in a group with initial membership of none.

message.description: The optional message id to display when the validator fails. This is only needed if the message to show is different to the validator definition.

groups.description:

Validation groups make it easier to run a subset of validators on a form. The validator will be enabled if any of the groups it is part of are enabled.

Note that a validation group with 'initialMembership: "all"' will include all validators (that aren't excluded), even if the validators do not include the group name.

include.description:

groups.description:
Zero or more validation group names this validator belongs to.

Validation groups make it easier to run a subset of validators on a form. The validator will be enabled if any of the groups it is part of are enabled.

Note that a validation group with 'initialMembership: "all"' will include all validators (that aren't excluded), even if the validators do not include the group name.

exclude.description:
A list of the validation groups to exclude / remove / disable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be excluded from a group with initial membership of all.

include.description:

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be included in a group with initial membership of none.

config.description: The configuration specific to the class of this form field.

defaultValue.description:
The default value for this model.

The server-side processing uses this as the default for the field. Defaults from ancestor fields will be combined to form the default value for a new record.

disabled.description:
Whether the form control should be disabled.

Disabled controls are excluded from the parent form's value.

Note that disabled here affects only the model's disabled state. Components can be disabled or not and readonly or not, independent of this property. Some components must link the component and model disabled state due to angular FormControl requirements.

editCssClasses.description: The optional css classes to be applied to the form dom node in edit mode.

newEntryValue.description:
The value to use when creating new entries in the repeatable.

Only available in a repeatable's elementTemplate in 'model.config.newEntryValue'.

The default value for a repeatable is specified in 'model.config.defaultValue'. The value for a repeatable is in 'model.config.value'.

validators.description: The validators that are configured at the field level that look at only this model.

items.description: The configuration block for a validator for a form or a form control.

class.description: The 'class' key used to reference one validator definition. The optional message and config will be applied to the validator definition with this class.

config.description: The optional validator config. Can be left out if the validator takes no config.

errorKey.description:
The key to use for this validator's entry in the merged errors object.

Defaults to the class. Set to a unique value when the same class is used more than once on a control, so Angular's error merging does not overwrite earlier instances.

targetField.description: Lineage paths to a target field that will 'own' any validation failures.

angularComponents.description: A lineage path is an ordered list of keys (string|number) describing a path lineage for different domains of form configuration. A string key is a property name or array index number as a string, a number key is an array index.

dataModel.description: A lineage path is an ordered list of keys (string|number) describing a path lineage for different domains of form configuration. A string key is a property name or array index number as a string, a number key is an array index.

formConfig.description: A lineage path is an ordered list of keys (string|number) describing a path lineage for different domains of form configuration. A string key is a property name or array index number as a string, a number key is an array index.

layout.description: A lineage path is an ordered list of keys (string|number) describing a path lineage for different domains of form configuration. A string key is a property name or array index number as a string, a number key is an array index.

groups.description:
Zero or more validation group names this validator belongs to.

Validation groups make it easier to run a subset of validators on a form. The validator will be enabled if any of the groups it is part of are enabled.

Note that a validation group with 'initialMembership: "all"' will include all validators (that aren't excluded), even if the validators do not include the group name.

exclude.description:
A list of the validation groups to exclude / remove / disable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be excluded from a group with initial membership of all.

include.description:
A list of the validation groups to include / add / enable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be included in a group with initial membership of none.

message.description: The optional message id to display when the validator fails. This is only needed if the message to show is different to the validator definition.

value.description:
The current value of this model.

The 'value' is only available after the form config has been processed, and the default values or the existing record values have been populated.

wrapperCssClasses.description: The optional css classes to be applied to the wrapper element.

module.description: For a custom form component definition, module defines where to find the definition.

name.description: top-level field name, applies to field and the component, etc.

overrides.description: Optional ways to extend or replace parts of the form config.

formModeClasses.description: When the form mode is the object key (one of the form modes), set the class as per the value object.

edit.description: The classes to transform to for each item that requires a class.

template.description: When the mode's transform produces a ContentComponent, this Handlebars template replaces the generated one. It renders with the client content-component context (`content` = the field's pruned value, plus `formData`, `branding`, `portal`, `oid`, `workflow`). The transformed component is made visible so edit-mode visibility defaults do not suppress the custom view. A layout hidden for edit mode is shown when transformed content is non-empty and remains hidden when it is empty. It is ignored when no transform to ContentComponent occurs.

The default value for this model.

The server-side processing uses this as the default for the field. Defaults from ancestor fields will be combined to form the default value for a new record.

disabled.description:
Whether the form control should be disabled.

Disabled controls are excluded from the parent form's value.

Note that disabled here affects only the model's disabled state. Components can be disabled or not and readonly or not, independent of this property. Some components must link the component and model disabled state due to angular FormControl requirements.

editCssClasses.description: The optional css classes to be applied to the form dom node in edit mode.

newEntryValue.description:
The value to use when creating new entries in the repeatable.

Only available in a repeatable's elementTemplate in 'model.config.newEntryValue'.

The default value for a repeatable is specified in 'model.config.defaultValue'. The value for a repeatable is in 'model.config.value'.

validators.description: The validators that are configured at the field level that look at only this model.

items.description: The configuration block for a validator for a form or a form control.

class.description: The 'class' key used to reference one validator definition. The optional message and config will be applied to the validator definition with this class.

config.description: The optional validator config. Can be left out if the validator takes no config.

errorKey.description:
The key to use for this validator's entry in the merged errors object.

Defaults to the class. Set to a unique value when the same class is used more than once on a control, so Angular's error merging does not overwrite earlier instances.

targetField.description: Lineage paths to a target field that will 'own' any validation failures.

angularComponents.description: A lineage path is an ordered list of keys (string|number) describing a path lineage for different domains of form configuration. A string key is a property name or array index number as a string, a number key is an array index.

dataModel.description: A lineage path is an ordered list of keys (string|number) describing a path lineage for different domains of form configuration. A string key is a property name or array index number as a string, a number key is an array index.

formConfig.description: A lineage path is an ordered list of keys (string|number) describing a path lineage for different domains of form configuration. A string key is a property name or array index number as a string, a number key is an array index.

layout.description: A lineage path is an ordered list of keys (string|number) describing a path lineage for different domains of form configuration. A string key is a property name or array index number as a string, a number key is an array index.

groups.description:
Zero or more validation group names this validator belongs to.

Validation groups make it easier to run a subset of validators on a form. The validator will be enabled if any of the groups it is part of are enabled.

Note that a validation group with 'initialMembership: "all"' will include all validators (that aren't excluded), even if the validators do not include the group name.

exclude.description:
A list of the validation groups to exclude / remove / disable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be excluded from a group with initial membership of all.

include.description:
A list of the validation groups to include / add / enable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be included in a group with initial membership of none.

message.description: The optional message id to display when the validator fails. This is only needed if the message to show is different to the validator definition.

value.description:
The current value of this model.

The 'value' is only available after the form config has been processed, and the default values or the existing record values have been populated.

wrapperCssClasses.description: The optional css classes to be applied to the wrapper element.

module.description: For a custom form component definition, module defines where to find the definition.

name.description: top-level field name, applies to field and the component, etc.

overrides.description: Optional ways to extend or replace parts of the form config.

formModeClasses.description: When the form mode is the object key (one of the form modes), set the class as per the value object.

edit.description: The classes to transform to for each item that requires a class.

template.description: When the mode's transform produces a ContentComponent, this Handlebars template replaces the generated one. It renders with the client content-component context (`content` = the field's pruned value, plus `formData`, `branding`, `portal`, `oid`, `workflow`). The transformed component is made visible so edit-mode visibility defaults do not suppress the custom view. A layout hidden for edit mode is shown when transformed content is non-empty and remains hidden when it is empty. It is ignored when no transform to ContentComponent occurs.

groups.description:
Zero or more validation group names this validator belongs to.

Validation groups make it easier to run a subset of validators on a form. The validator will be enabled if any of the groups it is part of are enabled.

Note that a validation group with 'initialMembership: "all"' will include all validators (that aren't excluded), even if the validators do not include the group name.

include.description:

groups.description:
Zero or more validation group names this validator belongs to.

Validation groups make it easier to run a subset of validators on a form. The validator will be enabled if any of the groups it is part of are enabled.

Note that a validation group with 'initialMembership: "all"' will include all validators (that aren't excluded), even if the validators do not include the group name.

exclude.description:
A list of the validation groups to exclude / remove / disable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be excluded from a group with initial membership of all.

include.description:
A list of the validation groups to include / add / enable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be included in a group with initial membership of none.

message.description: The optional message id to display when the validator fails. This is only needed if the message to show is different to the validator definition.

value.description:

groups.description:
Zero or more validation group names this validator belongs to.

Validation groups make it easier to run a subset of validators on a form. The validator will be enabled if any of the groups it is part of are enabled.

Note that a validation group with 'initialMembership: "all"' will include all validators (that aren't excluded), even if the validators do not include the group name.

include.description:

tooltip.description: The tooltip text translation message id.

valueMode.description: "value" stores the selected option value as a string. "optionObject" stores an object. Without optionObjectFields that object is { label, value, sourceType }; with optionObjectFields it uses the configured persisted property names and source paths.

visible.description: Whether the component is visible or not.

vocabRef.description: Some existing hooks use vocabRef as the domain identifier for namedQuery typeaheads, for example ROR-backed lookups. Runtime validation still keys namedQuery sources from queryId, but the frame accepts vocabRef so those configs remain type-safe and can be migrated without blocking compilation.

autofocus.description: Whether the component has autofocus or not.

disabled.description:
Whether the component is disabled or not.

Note that disabled affects only the component's interactivity. Disabled is separate from readonly, they can be set independently.

editMode.description: Whether the component is in edit mode or not.

hostCssClasses.description: The css classes to bind to host

label.description: The label text translation message id.

noResultsMessageKey.description: Translation key rendered when a completed lookup returns no options. Omit it to use TypeaheadInputDefaultNoResultsMessageKey.

clearValue.description: Value to set when selection is cleared. Defaults to null. Should be type-compatible with the target control (e.g. string for text inputs, null for optional fields).

rawPath.description: Dot-path into selectedItem.raw (or selectedItem) to extract this field's value

optionObjectFields.description: Maps stored object property names to paths on the selected option/raw result. Use this only with valueMode: "optionObject" when a form needs a domain-specific stored object, for example { dc_title: "dc_title", grant_number: "grant_number" }. When omitted, optionObject mode keeps the legacy label/value/sourceType shape.

readonly.description:
Whether the component is read-only or not.

Note that readonly affects only the component's interactivity. Readonly is separate from disabled, they can be set independently.

showValidIndicator.description: Whether to show a visual valid indicator (e.g. Bootstrap is-valid style) when the field has no errors. Defaults to false.

staticOptions.description: Static options are required for sourceType: "static"; remote configs may still carry an empty array from older defaults, so this remains common.

disabled.description: Indicates the option should be shown but cannot be selected in the current UI state. Historical vocabulary values are disabled in `historicalVocabMode: 'disable'`, but non-historical options may also be disabled for unrelated reasons.

historical.description: Indicates the option came from a historical/deprecated vocabulary entry. This source metadata is preserved even when the option remains selectable.

targetField.description: Lineage paths to a target field that will 'own' any validation failures.

angularComponents.description: A lineage path is an ordered list of keys (string|number) describing a path lineage for different domains of form configuration. A string key is a property name or array index number as a string, a number key is an array index.

dataModel.description: A lineage path is an ordered list of keys (string|number) describing a path lineage for different domains of form configuration. A string key is a property name or array index number as a string, a number key is an array index.

layout.description: A lineage path is an ordered list of keys (string|number) describing a path lineage for different domains of form configuration. A string key is a property name or array index number as a string, a number key is an array index.

groups.description:
Zero or more validation group names this validator belongs to.

Validation groups make it easier to run a subset of validators on a form. The validator will be enabled if any of the groups it is part of are enabled.

Note that a validation group with 'initialMembership: "all"' will include all validators (that aren't excluded), even if the validators do not include the group name.

exclude.description:
A list of the validation groups to exclude / remove / disable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be excluded from a group with initial membership of all.

include.description:
A list of the validation groups to include / add / enable.

Default is empty array. Use when a validator should be included in a group with initial membership of none.

message.description: The optional message id to display when the validator fails. This is only needed if the message to show is different to the validator definition.

groups.description:

Validation groups make it easier to run a subset of validators on a form. The validator will be enabled if any of the groups it is part of are enabled.

include.description:

Validation groups make it easier to run a subset of validators on a form. The validator will be enabled if any of the groups it is part of are enabled.

Note that a validation group with 'initialMembership: "all"' will include all validators (that aren't excluded), even if the validators do not include the group name.
